shots.visual: Holding a silk treaty document, looking at it with intense hatred and a cold smile.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，這份盟約就是個笑話。

shots.visual: Throwing the silk document into a burning bronze fire pit next to the throne.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 背信棄義之輩，不配與我為盟。

shots.visual: Wide eyes, holding a feather fan, looking completely shocked by the action.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公不可！此舉恐引發大戰！

shots.visual: Turning head sharply toward the camera, eyes piercing and resolute.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 大戰？朕等的就是這場大戰！

shots.visual: A messenger from Wu stands arrogantly in the middle of the hall, pointing at the burning silk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 吳國使臣在殿下憤怒叫囂。

shots.visual: Walking down the stairs from the throne, hand gripping the hilt of the sword.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 誰給你的膽子，在朕面前狂吠？

shots.visual: Sword being unsheathed, the blade reflecting cold light onto the protagonist's face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 拿你的頭，去祭奠荊州英靈！

shots.visual: Closing eyes and sighing, shaking the head as blood splashes across the floor tiles.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公變了，變得殺伐果斷。

shots.visual: Wiping blood off the blade with a white silk cloth, face expressionless.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令下去，全軍集結！

shots.visual: Standing among the shocked officials, pointing the sword toward the southeast.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 目標，建業！

shots.visual: Standing on the deck of a massive warship, looking at the distant horizon with suspicion.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備那邊有消息了嗎？

shots.visual: A soldier brings a wooden box, kneeling and trembling in front of the lord.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 劉備的宣戰書送抵東吳。

shots.visual: Opening the box with a frown, revealing a blood-stained short sword inside.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 這是……朕派去的使臣？

shots.visual: Picking up the bloody sword, seeing the protagonist's private seal engraved on the hilt.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 他竟敢公然殺我使臣！

shots.visual: Face turning pale, hands shaking as the realization of total war hits.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備真的瘋了，他要決死戰？

shots.visual: Turning to the generals behind, shouting with desperate energy.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 封鎖長江，調集所有水軍！

shots.visual: Clad in silver armor, sitting before a map, placing a black stone on the Wu capital.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，這一世，你無處可逃。

shots.visual: Peeking through the tent curtain, eyes full of conflict and hidden tears.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 夫君，你真要滅我東吳嗎？

shots.visual: Looking toward the curtain, knowing she is there but remaining cold and firm.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 負我者，皆不可留。

shots.visual: The camera looks over the lord's shoulder at thousands of burning torches on the horizon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 蜀漢大軍，已兵臨城下。

shots.visual: The bloody sword in the lord's hand suddenly trembles as a dark shadow looms over the ship.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 那……那是劉備的帥旗？
